book.title: LABAARI GEA NGE MƐ MAAKU U YORUA

content: Wiruɡibɑ wesiɑnɑmɔ
bu kɑ Yesu ɡo
N wee, n tie sɔ̃ɔ yiru bu kɑ Gɔɔ sɑrɑribu kɑ pɛ̃ɛ ye bɑ kun seeyɑtiɑ doken tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑru ko. Mɑ yɑ̃ku kowo tɔnwerobu kɑ woodɑ yɛ̃robu bɑ swɑɑ kɑsu bu kɑ Yesu mwɑ ɑsiri sɔɔ bu ɡo,
domi bɑ ɡerumɔ bɑ mɔ̀, n ǹ weenɛ bu ko tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑ te sɔɔ, kpɑ n ku rɑɑ ko ɡɑri bɑkɑ tɔmbun suunu sɔɔ.
Kurɔ ɡoo turɑre yɛ̃kɑ
Yesun wirɔ

Sɑnɑm mɛ Yesu u wɑ̃ɑ Betɑniɔ Simɔɔn yɛnuɔ wi u rɑɑ bɑrɑ disiɡiru mɔ, kurɔ ɡoo u nɑ win mi u too burɑru nɛni te bɑ kuɑ kɑ ɑbɑtiri, te tɑ turɑre ɡobi bɛkɛɡiɑ yibɑ ye bɑ kuɑ kɑ nɑɑdin ɡum. U too te kɔrɑ mɑ u turɑre ye yɛ̃kɑ Yesun wirɔ sɑnɑm mɛ u dimɔ.
Gɑbu bɑ sɔ̃ɔnɑmɔ kɑ mɔru bɑ nɛɛ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ u turɑre ye kɑm koosiɑ.
Sɑ ko rɑɑ kpĩ su ye dɔrɑ yu ko sɔm kowon wɔ̃ɔ tiɑn kɔsiɑrun sɑkɑ, kpɑ su ɡobi yi sɑ̃ɑrobu bɔnu kuɑ. Mɑ bɑ kurɔ wi wɔkisi.
Adɑmɑ Yesu u nɛɛ, i nùn derio. Mbɑ n kuɑ i kɑ nùn wɔkisimɔ. Gɑ̃ɑ burɑnɑ u mɑn kuɑ.
Bɑɑdommɑwɑ sɑ̃ɑrobu bɑ wɑ̃ɑ bɛɛn suunu sɔɔ. Sɑnɑm bɑɑmɛre mɛ i kĩ, i ko kpĩ i bu durom kuɑ. Adɑmɑ nɛnɑ nɑ ǹ ko nɑ n wɑ̃ɑ kɑ bɛɛ kɑ bɑɑdommɑ.
U kuɑ nɡe mɛ win mɔrɑ nɛ. U nɑwɑ u kɑ nɛn wɑsin sikubun sɔɔru ko bu sere yi sike.
Kɑ ɡeemɑ nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ, bɑɑmɑ mi bɑ Lɑbɑɑri ɡeɑ wɑɑsu mɔ̀ hɑnduniɑ kpuro sɔɔ, bɑ koo mɑɑ kurɔ win ɡɑri ɡere ye u kuɑ minin sɔ̃, bɑ n kɑ nùn yɑɑye.
Yudɑsi u kĩ u Yesu yɑ̃ku kowo
tɔnwerobu nɔmu sɔndiɑ
Yen biru Yudɑsi Isikɑriɔtu, bwɑ̃ɑbu wɔkurɑ yiru yen turo, u dɑ yɑ̃ku kowo tɔnwerobun mi u kɑ bu Yesu nɔmu sɔndiɑ.
Ben nukurɑ dorɑ ɡem ɡem ye bɑ win ɡɑri nuɑ mɑ bɑ nùn ɡobi nɔɔ mwɛɛru kuɑ yi bɑ koo nùn kɛ̃. Mɑ u swɑɑ kɑsu nɡe mɛ u koo ko u kɑ Yesu bu nɔmu sɔndiɑ ù n sɑɑ wɑ.
Yesu u Gɔɔ sɑrɑribun yɑɑ dibu
dimɔ kɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbu
Pɛ̃ɛ ye bɑ kun seeyɑtiɑ doken tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑrun tɔ̃ɔ ɡbiikiru, tè sɔɔ bɑ rɑ Gɔɔ sɑrɑribun yɑ̃ɑnu ɡo, Yesun bwɑ̃ɑbɑ nɑ win mi bɑ nɛɛ, mɑnɑ ɑ kĩ su nun Gɔɔ sɑrɑribun yɑɑ dibun sɔɔru kuɑ.
Yerɑ Yesu u win bwɑ̃ɑbun yiru ɡɔrɑ u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, i doo wuu sɔɔ, i ko kɑ durɔ ɡoo yinnɑ u nim tooru sɔɔwɑ. I nùn swĩiyɔ.
Yɛnu mi u duɑ, i yɛnu ɡen yɛ̃ro sɔ̃ɔwɔ i nɛɛ, yinni u nɛɛ, diru mɑnɑ wi kɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbu bɑ koo be Gɔɔ sɑrɑribun yɑɑ dibu di.
Durɔ wi, u koo bɛɛ ɡidɑmbisɑ bɑkɑ sɔ̃ɔsi ye bɑ sɔɔru kuɑ kɑ ɡɑ̃ɑ nìn bukɑtɑ sɑ mɔ kpuro. Miyɑ i ko i sun Gɔɔ sɑrɑribun sɔɔru kuɑ.
Mɑ bwɑ̃ɑ be, bɑ swɑɑ wɔri bɑ turɑ wuu ɡen mi, bɑ ye kpuro wɑ nɡe mɛ Yesu u rɑɑ bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ. Mɑ bɑ Gɔɔ sɑrɑribun yɑɑ dibu sɔɔru kuɑ.
Ye n kuɑ yokɑ Yesu u dɑ mi kɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbu wɔkurɑ yiru ye.
Ye bɑ sɔ̃ bɑ dimɔ Yesu u nɛɛ, kɑ ɡeemɑ nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ, bɛɛn turo wi u dimɔ kɑ nɛ sɑnnu u koo mɑn dɔmɛ.
Yeyɑ bwɑ̃ɑ be kpuron nuki sɑnkirɑ, mɑ bɑ nùn bikiɑbu wɔri tiɑ tiɑ bɑ mɔ̀, ɑsɑ n ǹ nɛ.
Mɑ Yesu u bu wisɑ u nɛɛ, bɛɛ wɔkurɑ yiru ye sɔɔ, nɛ kɑ wi sɑ ɡbɛ̃ɛ teeru sɔ̃rɑmɔ, wiyɑ.
Kɑ ɡeemɑ, Tɔnun Bii u koo ɡbi nɡe mɛ Gusunɔn ɡɑri ɡerumɔ win sɔ̃. Adɑmɑ nɔni swɑ̃ɑruɡiiwɑ wi u koo nùn dɔmɛ. N sɑnɔ bɑ kun dɑɑ yɛ̃ro mɑrɑ.
Yinnin dĩɑ domɑruɡinu
Mi bɑ dimɔ mi, Yesu u pɛ̃ɛ suɑ u Gusunɔ siɑrɑ mɑ u ye mururɑ u win bwɑ̃ɑbu wɛ̃. U nɛɛ, i mɔɔ, yeniwɑ nɛn wɑsi.
U mɑɑ nɔrɑ suɑ u Gusunɔ siɑrɑ mɑ u bu wɛ̃, mɑ be kpuro bɑ nɔrɑ.
Mɑ Yesu u nɛɛ, yeniwɑ nɛn yɛm mɛ mu Gusunɔn nɔɔ mwɛɛ kpɑɑru sire. Mu koo mɑɑ yɑri tɔn dɑbinun sɔ̃.
Kɑ ɡeemɑ nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ, nɑ ǹ mɑɑ tɑm mɛni nɔrumɔ sere n kɑ ko sɑnɑm mɛ kon mɛn kpɑm nɔ bɑn te Gusunɔ u koo swĩi sɔɔ.
Ye bɑ womusu kuɑ bɑ kpɑ, yerɑ bɑ yɑrɑ bɑ dɑ Olifin ɡuuru wɔllɔ.
Yesu u nɛɛ, Piɛɛ koo nùn siki
Olifin ɡuuru miyɑ Yesu u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, bɛɛ kpurowɑ i ko i biru wurɑ. Domi bɑ yoruɑ Gusunɔn ɡɑri sɔɔ bɑ nɛɛ, “Bɑ koo yɑ̃ɑ kpɑro ɡo, kpɑ yɑ̃ɑnu nu yɑrinɑ.”
Adɑmɑ nɑ̀ n seewɑ ɡɔrin di kon bɛɛ ɡbiiyɑ Gɑlileɔ.
Yerɑ Piɛɛ nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, bɑɑ tɔmbu kpuro bɑ̀ n biru wurɑmɔ, n ǹ kɑ nɛ!
Yesu u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, kɑ ɡeemɑ nɑ nun sɔ̃ɔmɔ, ɡisɔn wɔ̃ku te, sere ɡoo dɔɔ ɡu kɑ swĩ nɔn yiru, kɑɑ mɑn siki nɔn itɑ.
Adɑmɑ Piɛɛ u nɔɔ ɡɛ̃ɛ dim dim u mɔ̀, nɑ ǹ nun sikimɔ pɑi. Bɑɑ ǹ n ɡɔɔn nɑ, sɑnnɑ sɑ ko ɡbi. Mɛyɑ mɑɑ bwɑ̃ɑ be kpuro bɑ ɡeruɑ.
Yesu u kɑnɑru mɔ̀ Gɛsemɑnɛɔ
Yen biru bɑ dɑ ɡɑm ɡum mi bɑ rɑ soku Gɛsemɑnɛ. Mɑ Yesu u win bwɑ̃ɑbu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, bu sinɔ mi, kpɑ u dɑ u kɑnɑru ko.
Mɑ u Piɛɛ kɑ Yɑkɔbu kɑ Yohɑnu sokɑ bɑ dɑ kɑ wi. Mɑ u nɑndɑ, win wɑsi dwiiyɑ.
Yerɑ u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, nɛn nukurɑ sɑnkirɑ sere n ɡɔɔ ɡum ɡirɑri. I yɔ̃ro mini kpɑ i n tii kpɑrenu sɑ̃ɑ.
Yen biru u bu dɛsirɑri fiiko u kpunɑ u kibɑri u kɑnɑru kuɑ, ǹ n koo koorɑ, wɑhɑlɑn sɑɑ ye, yu nùn dɛsirɑri.
Yerɑ u ɡeruɑ u nɛɛ, nɛn Bɑɑbɑ, kɑɑ kpĩ ɑ ɡɑ̃ɑnu kpuro ko. A de wɑhɑlɑ ye, yu mɑn dɛsirɑri. Adɑmɑ ɑ ku nɛn ɡɔ̃ru kĩru ko mɑ n kun mɔ wunɛɡiru.
Mɑ u wurɑmɑ bwɑ̃ɑbu itɑ ben mi, u deemɑ bɑ dò. Mɑ u Piɛɛ bikiɑ u nɛɛ, Simɔɔ ɑ dòwɑ? A kpɑnɑ ɑ n wɑsi bɑɑ kɔbi tiɑ?
I n tii kpɑrenu sɑ̃ɑ i n kɑnɑru mɔ̀, kpɑ i ku rɑ du kɔkiribu sɔɔ. Kɑ ɡeemɑ, tɔnun ɡɔ̃ru ɡɑ kĩ ɑdɑmɑ wɑsi yen dɑm bie.
Mɑ u kpɑm wurɑ u kɑnɑru kuɑ. Gɑri tee yiyɑ u ɡerumɔ.
Ye u kpɑm wurɑmɑ u deemɑ bɑ do domi ben nɔni buniɑ. Bɑ ǹ mɑɑ yɛ̃ ye bɑ koo nùn sɔ̃.
Ye u wurɑmɑ ben mi nɔn itɑse u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, i den dweeyo tɛ̃, kpɑ i wɛ̃rɑ. N turɑ mɛ. Sɑɑ ye, yɑ tunumɑ kɔ. N wee, bɑ Tɔnun Bii tɔn kɔ̃sobu nɔmu sɔndiɑmmɛ.
I seewo su doonɑ. Wee, wi u mɑn dɔmɛmɔ u sisi.
Yesun mwɑɑbu
Yesu kun ɡɑri yi ɡerum kpɑ Yudɑsi kɑ tunumɑ yɑnde, bwɑ̃ɑbu wɔkurɑ yiru yen turo. Tɔn dɑbirɑ nùn swĩi bɑ tɑkobibɑ kɑ bokunu nɛni. Yɑ̃ku kowo tɔnwerobu kɑ woodɑ yɛ̃robu kɑ ɡuro ɡurobɑ bɑ bu ɡɔrɑ.
N deemɑ dɔmɛ wi, u rɑɑ tɔn be sɔ̃ɔwɑ yĩre te u koo ko. U nɛɛ, durɔ wi u koo nɛnɛ u bɔkɑsi, wiyɑ mi, bu nùn mɔɔ, bu nɛnɛ kem kem bu kɑ doonɑ.
Ye Yudɑsi tunumɑ, mii mii u dɑ Yesun mi, mɑ u nɛɛ, yinni. Mɑ u nùn bɔkɑsi.
Yerɑ tɔn be, bɑ nɔmu dɛmiɑ bɑ Yesu mwɑ.
Adɑmɑ be bɑ yɔ̃ min turo u win tɑkobi womɑ, mɑ u yɑ̃ku kowo tɔnweron yoon soo sɔ̃rɑ u burɑ.
Yerɑ Yesu bu bikiɑ u nɛɛ, nɛnɑ bɛɛ i mwɑɑbu nɑ kɑ tɑkobibɑ kɑ bokunu nɡe swɑɑ dio?
Bɑɑdommɑwɑ nɑ rɑ n kɑ bɛɛ wɑ̃ɑ sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ nɑ n keu sɔ̃ɔsimɔ, mɑ i ǹ mɑn mwɛ. Adɑmɑ Gusunɔn ɡɑri yi ǹ koo ko yi kun koore.
Yerɑ bwɑ̃ɑ be kpuro bɑ yɑrinɑ bɑ nùn deri.
Aluwɑɑsi ɡoo mɑɑ Yesu swĩi biruɔ u bekuru wukiri. Yerɑ ɡɑbɑ kĩ bu nùn mwɑ,
ɑdɑmɑ u dukɑ tereru, u bu bekuru deriɑ.
Bɑ Yesu sirimɔ
Yuubɑn tɔnwerobun mɛnnɔ yerɔ
Sɑnɑm mɛyɑ bɑ kɑ Yesu dɑ yɑ̃ku kowo tɔnweron yɛnuɔ mi yɑ̃ku kowo tɔnwerobu kɑ ɡuro ɡurobu kɑ mɑɑ woodɑ yɛ̃robu bɑ mɛnnɛ.
Mɑ Piɛɛ u bu swĩi dɑndɑnkuru sere kɑ yɑ̃ku kowo tɔnweron yɛnu yɑɑrɑɔ. Miyɑ u sinɑ, wi kɑ tɑbu kowobu sɑnnu bɑ dɔ̃ɔ wɔ̃su.
Yɑ̃ku kowo tɔnwerobu kɑ mɑɑ ɡuro ɡurobun mɛnnɔ ɡe kpuro bɑ seedɑ kɑsu ye bɑ koo Yesu mɑni bu kɑ nùn ɡo. Adɑmɑ bɑ ǹ wɑ.
Domi tɔn dɑbiru tɑ nùn seedɑ weesuɡiɑ diisimɔ ɑdɑmɑ seedɑɡii be, bɑ ǹ nɔɔ tiɑ sɑ̃ɑ.
Yerɑ ɡɑbɑ seewɑ bɑ nùn weesu mɑni bɑ nɛɛ,
bɛsɛ sɑ nuɑ u nɛɛ u koo sɑ̃ɑ yeru surɑ te bɑ kɑ nɔmɑ bɑnɑ, kpɑ sɔ̃ɔ itɑn bɑɑ sɔɔ u be ten kpɑɑru bɑni te bɑ ǹ kɑ nɔmɑ bɑnɛ.
Kɑ mɛ, bɑɑ ɡɑri yinin tii sɔɔ bɑ ǹ nɔɔ tiɑ kue.
Mɑ yɑ̃ku kowo tɔnwero u seewɑ u yɔ̃rɑ be kpuron wuswɑɑɔ, u Yesu bikiɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ ǹ ɡɛɛ wisimɔ? Mbɑ tɔn beni bɑ nun sɑɑrisimɔ.
Adɑmɑ Yesu u mɑɑri piti, u ǹ bu ɡɑ̃ɑnu wisɑ. Yerɑ yɑ̃ku kowo tɔnwero wi, u kpɑm nùn bikiɑ u nɛɛ, wunɑ Kirisi wi? Gusunɔ Yinni wi sɑ siɑrɑmɔn Bii?
Mɑ Yesu u nɛɛ, oo, nɛnɑ mi. Sɔ̃ɔ teeru i ko Tɔnun Bii wɑ u sɔ̃ Dɑm Kpuroɡiin nɔm ɡeuɔ, u wee wɔllun di ɡuru winu sɔɔ.
Sɑnɑm mɛyɑ yɑ̃ku kowo tɔnwero u win tiin yɑberu nɛnuɑ u kɑrɑnɑ, mɑ u nɛɛ, ee, seedɑ yerɑ̀ i mɑɑ kɑsu.
Bɛɛ i nuɑ ɡɑri kɑm yi u ɡeruɑ. Amɔnɑ i wɑ durɔ wi sɔɔ. Mɑ be kpuro bɑ nùn tɑɑrɛ wɛ̃ bɑ nɛɛ, bu nùn ɡo.
Yerɑ ben ɡɑbɑ yɑnde nùn yɑ̃ɑtɑm siem wɔri, bɑ win nɔni wɔ̃kuɑ, mɑ bɑ nùn nɔm kusɑ soomɔ, bɑ nɛɛ u tubuo wi u nùn soomɔ. Mɑ tɑbu kowobu bɑ nùn mwɑ bɑ soomɔ.
Piɛɛ u Yesu siki
Sɑnɑm mɛ Piɛɛ u wɑ̃ɑ yɛnu yɑɑrɑɔ, yerɑ wɔndiɑ ɡoo wi u sɔmburu mɔ̀ yɑ̃ku kowo tɔnweron mi u nɑ mi.
Ye u Piɛɛ wɑ u dɔ̃ɔ wɔ̃su, u nùn mɛɛrɑ tii. Yerɑ u nɛɛ, wunɛ mɑɑ, ɑ rɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ kɑ Yesu Nɑsɑrɛtiɡii sɑnnu.
Adɑmɑ Piɛɛ u ɡɑri yi siki, u nɛɛ, nɑ ǹ yɛ̃ fɑ, yɑ ǹ mɑn yeeri ye ɑ ɡerumɔ. Mɑ u yɑrɑ u dɑ ɡonɡoroso ɡiɑ. [Sɑɑ yerɑ ɡoo dɔɔ ɡɑ swĩ.]
Wɔndiɑ sɔm kowo wi, u kpɑm nùn wɑ mi, mɑ u be bɑ yɔ̃ mi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, durɔ win tɔmbun turowɑ mini.
Adɑmɑ Piɛɛ u kpɑm ɡɑri yi siki. Ye n tɛ fiiko, be bɑ yɔ̃ mi bɑ Piɛɛ sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ, kɑ ɡem, wunɛ tɔn ben turowɑ domi wunɛn tii Gɑlileɡiiwɑ.
Yerɑ Piɛɛ u bɔ̃ruɑ u sɔnnɑ u nɛɛ, nɑ ǹ durɔ wi yɛ̃ wi bɛɛ i kɑ yɑ̃ mini.
Mii mii mɑ ɡoo dɔɔ ɡɑ swĩ nɔn mɛɛruse. Yerɑ u Yesun ɡɑri yɑɑyɑ yi u rɑɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, sere ɡoo dɔɔ ɡu kɑ swĩ nɔn yiru, u koo nùn siki nɔn itɑ. Mɑ u swĩi wɔri.
